videos.title: How 21 People Built a $100M+ Agent Company — Quinn Slack, Amp
videos.summary: Traditional software development and bloated SaaS giants are staring down an existential collapse: autonomous AI agents now allow hyper-lean teams to out-build and out-iterate massive enterprise orgs overnight. Former Sourcegraph CEO Quinn Slack breaks down the radical playbook of running a 21-person company that scrapped Jira, PMs, and sales teams to build Amp entirely with agents—proving that lean, agent-driven operations can ship higher-quality software at a fraction of the cost. If you want a practical, eye-opening look at how software creation is permanently shifting and how to avoid being trapped in obsolete workflows, this talk is an essential watch.
